purpose: Screen one participant_adaptation_observation family for actual baseline difficulty. No skill-lift, backend-identity, installed-skill activation, or confirmation claim follows from this draft.

model.backend_identity: Record host evidence separately; requested labels do not prove the effective backend or effort.

inputs.writer_access: D2C and the prospectively authored D2H are both writer-seen. D2H is a different same-family instance, not a blind or inaccessible holdout.
inputs.freeze: Require independent construct and oracle reviews, then exact-byte SHA256 freeze of cases, rubrics, protocol, root and three references before any actual screening dispatch. Repairs after a review require renewed review of affected work. Never edit frozen inputs after dispatch.

scoring.judging: Blind arm labels; grade only final answers against task-specific anchors. Accept concise valid answers without requiring phrases, exhaustive alternatives, private reasoning or framework labels. Charge one root error once unless separately consequential.
scoring.missing: A missing output is NOT_RUN or host failure, never score zero. Retain every planned slot and actual outcome.

screening.exclude_if: At least 2 of 3 full passes OR normalized mean strictly greater than 0.70
screening.incomplete: A missing trial leaves this family screening-incomplete and unselected; never replace the missing outcome.
screening.zero_pass: Retain a 0/3 family only after an independent reviewer verifies a feasible oracle or decision-useful uncertainty answer and task clarity.
screening.selection: Outcome-blind to treatment. Preserve exclusions and reasons. No scored treatment before screening selection freezes.
screening.insufficient_retention: One family cannot satisfy the unchanged six-family minimum alone. Report any validly hard result as a candidate contribution only; never claim a difficult core or treatment estimate.
screening.no_later_filter: Do not filter confirmation by either arm's outcome.

confirmation.families: Only D2H if D2C is validly hard and a separately authorized qualifying core reaches six families.
confirmation.revision_rule: Any tuned or revised D2H becomes development; use a prospective replacement and new freeze, never replace an unfavorable outcome.

controls.score_reporting: Separate conventional-winning check outside the difficult core; no selection by control outcome.

counterfactual_links.D2K: With sufficient confirmed fallback capacity, keep the current simple contract and resolve all registered refusals.

controls.comparability: Descriptive only: control conditions differ from D2C.

budget.formula: 3 baseline screening + up to 6 confirmation + 2 control = at most 11 scored outputs, below the unchanged 114 per-pool ceiling.
budget.canary: Unscored and outside the model-output budget; record separately.

runtime.common_instructions: Same host context, task bytes, tool prohibition, final-answer budget and common system instructions across arms; record unmatched host context.

turn_order.method: Freeze randomized order before dispatch; alternate arm order across repetition blocks if confirmation is ever authorized.
turn_order.screening: Three independent fresh baseline sessions for D2C only.

treatment.delivery: Captured native order: task, explicitly preloaded frozen inquiry-methods, evidence-and-diagnosis, alternatives-and-drafting references, then native root expansion named deep-inquiry:deep-inquiry.
treatment.record: Capture exact delivered bytes/order and hashes; never deliver cases, rubrics or private oracles as treatment hints.
treatment.estimand: Effect of delivered root plus three-reference package, not natural triggering or root alone.

runtime.baseline: No treatment root or references. Verify absence of autoexpansion and prior answer context; unresolved contamination prevents matched comparison.
runtime.canary: Before any scored stage, prove dispatch and result capture with an unscored neutral task.

retries.allowed_only: Host trace proves no model turn dispatched.
retries.ambiguous_dispatch: No retry; preserve unknown as host failure/NOT_RUN.

reporting.preserve: All planned slots, outputs, scores, critical failures, missing/host failures, exclusions, model/effort evidence and comparison limits.
reporting.primary: If later eligible, report D2H arm scores and full-pass rates by family and paired slot, with denominator; no aggregate skill-lift claim from this one family.
limitations: Difficulty remains unknown until real screening.
The candidate alone cannot meet the six-family core minimum.
D2H is writer-seen and not a blind holdout.
Requested model labels alone do not prove effective identity or isolated instruction exposure.
reporting.no_result: No model turns were run to author or validate this draft.

provenance.retired_comparison: Distinct from pool-2 C04's all-or-nothing coverage payment and pool-3 C04's original-ticket audit/recurrence mechanism: here the independent complete intake and limited confirmed fallback affect attainable total outcomes under provider selection.
provenance.treatment_package: Existing method-only root and three references unchanged.
